items.q: Can we get a sizing kit?
items.a: Yes. Ask when you request your quote and we'll send a sizing kit of sample garments so players can try before you confirm the size run. Kits are loaned — we ask for them back within two weeks. Freight both ways is on us for orders of 20 garments or more; for smaller orders we'll quote it. See our [sizing and fit assurance policy](/policies/sizing-fit).

Most garments run from junior Y4 through to Y16, then adult XS to 12XL, in men's and women's cuts. A few sport-specific cuts, like rugby and volleyball jerseys, have their own range, and larger sizes are available on request. Every size is graded from the same design so the whole club matches. Measurements are on our [size charts](/size-charts).

items.q: What if a garment doesn't fit?
items.a: If we've made a garment to a size you confirmed, we can't exchange it — it's custom made. If we've made it to the wrong size, or it's outside our measurement tolerance, we'll remake it at no cost. Our [sizing and fit assurance policy](/policies/sizing-fit) explains the tolerances.
